firstViewportText: Metformin (C4H11N5) Controlled substance · Professional supervision is normally required. A regulator classifies this substance in a way that restricts how it is supplied. The US label carries a boxed warning. In 10 seconds Does it work? How it works Safety Interactions For someone like me?
